name: New Zealand Standards (NZS 1170.5, NZS 3101, NZS 3404)
description: The New Zealand Standards (alpha 9 track C18), a pack that extends the Australian pack where the joint standards are equal: AS/NZS 1170.0, 1170.1 and 1170.2:2021 (the combinations, imposed actions and wind, the New Zealand wind regions NZ1-NZ4 in the towns) and the steel members (NZS 3404 Part 1 has the member rules of AS 4100: φ 0.9, αc with αb, αm αs). Its own: NZS 1170.5:2004 earthquake actions (Z of the towns, site subsoil classes A-E with the spectral shape factor Ch(T), the near-fault factor N(T,D), the return period factor R, Sp and kμ from the structural ductility factor μ, Cd(T) = C(T) Sp/kμ with its least values, the equivalent static method with Ft = 0.08 V and the modal method, the 2.5 % drift limit) and NZS 3101:2006 A3 concrete (φ 0.85 for flexure with or without axial force, shear and torsion 0.75, the axial cap 0.85 φ N0, the stress block α1 and β1, vc = (0.07 + 10 ρw) √f'c, Ec = 4700 √f'c, the 500E bars HD10-HD40, the overstrength factor λo 1.25 of 500E in the capacity design the program makes for ductile members). Not covered and taken from the parent packs (named so): the NZS 3101 ductile detailing and capacity design beyond the program's probable-moment rules (Appendix D dynamic magnification, the ductile wall rules of 11.4), NZS 3404 Section 12 seismic categories, punching, torsion, walls, footings, connections, masonry and timber. Every value names its clause; VERIFY.md lists them, with the uncertain ones.
